en.title: Snow in Bosnia and Herzegovina today: how much is on the ground, 16 November 2026
en.description: Bosnia and Herzegovina snow today, 16 November: snow cover, new snow, snow depth by height, the next days and the best resorts.
en.lede: Snow covers roughly 490 km² in Bosnia and Herzegovina on 16 November, down 600 km² on yesterday. Roughly 2 % of the country's mapped mountains and hills are covered.

p: The snow line sits near 2,000 m. A week ago it was 200 km², so the cover has grown by 290 km².
Bjelašnica and Jahorina got the most fresh snow over three days, up to 3 cm.

Height makes the difference: between 500 and 1,000 m, under 1 cm on average, 2 % covered; between 1,000 and 1,500 m, under 1 cm on average, 2 % covered; between 1,500 and 2,000 m, under 1 cm on average, 3 % covered.
The snow is retreating uphill, so plan on the higher lifts and avoid the low valley runs.
With more snow in the forecast, the next days should improve things further.
Skijalište Kozara leads with 24 cm on its upper slopes.
Next on the list: Igrišta olimpijski centar (20 cm), Ponijeri ski centar (20 cm), Ski centar Vlašić (20 cm) and Jahorina olimpijski centar (1 cm).
Igrišta olimpijski centar picked up 1 cm in the last three days and could add 0 cm by Thursday 19 November.
6 of the 12 resorts we follow in Bosnia and Herzegovina have snow on their upper slopes.
Snow is in the forecast: up to 0 cm by the end of the third day, up to 15 cm within seven days.
Monday 23 November stands out, with up to 11 cm in a day.
The second week adds up to 16 cm where it snows most.

advice: Snow above the tree line can be wind-packed: watch the ridges.
Fresh snow on a cold base sticks badly: take care on steep slopes.
Roads to the higher resorts may need winter tyres or chains.

bs.title: Snijeg u Bosni i Hercegovini danas: visina snježnog pokrivača i novi snijeg, 16. novembra 2026.
bs.description: Snijeg u Bosni i Hercegovini 16. novembra: snježni pokrivač, novi snijeg, visina po nadmorskoj visini, naredni dani i najbolji ski-centri.
bs.lede: U Bosni i Hercegovini je danas pod snijegom oko 490 km² (ponedjeljak, 16. novembra). To je 600 km² manje nego jučer. To je 2 % planinskog područja u Bosni i Hercegovini koje pratimo.

p: U odnosu na 200 km² prije sedam dana, to je rast od 290 km². Teren je pretežno bijel od oko 2.000 m naviše.

Prosječna visina snježnog pokrivača po visini: 500–1.000 m: prosječno manje od 1 cm (2 % pod snijegom); 1.000–1.500 m: prosječno manje od 1 cm (2 % pod snijegom); 1.500–2.000 m: prosječno manje od 1 cm (3 % pod snijegom).
Otopljenje topi pokrivač: ujutro tvrd snijeg, poslijepodne mokar.
Uz snijeg u prognozi, naredni dani trebali bi biti bolji.
Trodnevne količine dostižu 3 cm. Najviše: Bjelašnica i Jahorina.
Prognoza novog snijega: do 0 cm za tri dana i do 15 cm za sedam dana.
Najsnježniji dan: ponedjeljak, 23. novembra, do 11 cm.
Kasnije, u danima 8–14, na najsnježnijim padinama može pasti još do 16 cm.
Najviše snijega na gornjim stazama: Skijalište Kozara, 24 cm.
Ski-centri sa snijegom na gornjim stazama: 6 od 12.
Slijede: Igrišta olimpijski centar (20 cm), Ponijeri ski centar (20 cm), Ski centar Vlašić (20 cm) i Jahorina olimpijski centar (1 cm).
Igrišta olimpijski centar: 1 cm novog snijega za tri dana i do datuma četvrtak, 19. novembra još do 0 cm.

advice: Prije polaska provjerite rade li liftovi.
